@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'Agent folder source: the iCloud Agents/ folder as one more layer of the catalog (D61)'
+---
+## Why
+
+Decision D61 of the SwissArmyHammer app: an iCloud folder `Agents/` is one more source of agents. Its layout is `Agents/<name>/AGENT.md`. It has no `agents/` level and no dot folder. The app gives the URL (from `FileManager.url(forUbiquityContainerIdentifier:)`). The package must not hard-code an iCloud path.
+
+## Problem in the current code
+
+- `AgentCatalogBuilder.build` makes one combined `DotfolderStack` and finds agents with `childDirectories(of: "agents")` and the path `agents/<id>/AGENT.md` (`AgentCatalogBuilder.swift:59`, `:124`). Each layer must have the `agents/` level.
+- `AgentBodyRenderer` renders the document at `agents/<id>/AGENT.md` of the winning layer, and the include walks `agents/<id>/_partials/` → `agents/_partials/` → `_partials/`.
+- We cannot use the container root as the layer root with `Agents` as the folder name: iOS file systems are case-sensitive, and `Agents` is not `agents`.
+
+## Plan
+
+1. Add a public type for an agent-folder source: a URL of a folder whose children are agent folders (`<root>/<name>/AGENT.md`). The host gives the URL. The package does not know that the URL is iCloud.
+2. In the builder and the renderer, map the path of each layer: a dotfolder layer uses `agents/<id>/AGENT.md`; an agent-folder source uses `<id>/AGENT.md`. The include walk of an agent-folder source is `<id>/_partials/` → `_partials/` of the source root. Find the smallest change: a per-layer "agents directory" prefix (`"agents"` or `""`), or a request to Extras for a mounted layer.
+3. Precedence (proposal to the app session): `marketplace[0] < … < marketplace[n] < defaults < user < agent folders < project`. The user edits the iCloud folder in Finder, thus it wins over the hidden `~/.agents` copy. The project stays highest because it is the most specific. The host gives the position; the convenience init puts it between user and project.
+4. A file that is not local yet:
+   - A placeholder (`.<name>.icloud` stub on iOS, or a dataless file) does not fail the catalog. The agent gives one diagnostic "not downloaded yet", and the build asks for the download (`FileManager.startDownloadingUbiquitousItem(at:)`). The next build after the download loads it.
+   - Ignore conflict files (`AGENT 2.md` and the like): only the exact name `AGENT.md` is an agent document. Report a visible iCloud conflict as an advisory if the API shows it (`NSFileVersion.unresolvedConflictVersionsOfItem`).
+   - Read with `NSFileCoordinator` for the agent-folder source.
+5. Change notifications: the `DotfolderWatcher` sees changes in the local folder. Downloads and changes from other devices come as file changes in that folder, thus `watch: true` must include the agent-folder roots. Also give the host one documented path: call `reload()` from its `NSMetadataQuery` updates. Find out if the watcher sees a placeholder that becomes a full file.
+6. iCloud off or not signed in: the host gives `nil` or a URL that does not exist. The source is then empty, with no error and no diagnostic.
+7. `description`: no change. An absent description is already a warning, and the agent is not in `modelVisible` (`LoadingTheCatalog.md:86`). Thus a model can select only an agent with a description.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- Tests with a temporary folder in the `Agents/<name>/AGENT.md` layout: load, precedence, hidden copy advisory, partials, placeholder file, conflict file, absent root.
+- The docs `LoadingTheCatalog.md` and `docs/skills-and-agents.md` tell the new source.
+- No iCloud path or container id in the package. #feature
\ No newline at end of file
